title: Portrait With Subtle Natural Motion
tests: Tests restrained portrait animation with temporal identity preservation rather than facial drift or a static-image zoom.

faults.what: A pronounced progressive zoom changes the original chest-up portrait into a tight facial close-up, cropping her hair and sweater despite the explicit fixed-camera, unchanged-framing requirement.
Facial details drift from the source: the eyes appear larger and more defined, and cheek marks become more prominent rather than preserving her face exactly.

judge.summary: The silent clip keeps her recognizable and shows a blink-like eyelid change, but an obvious progressive zoom violates the requested still framing.

must_haves.item: The woman remains recognizably the same person as in the attachment across the entire clip.
must_haves.why: She remains recognizably the same woman in all supplied frames.

must_haves.item: A natural blink and subtle breathing movement are visible.
must_haves.why: The lowered eyelids at 1.9 seconds are consistent with a blink, but the sampled frames cannot establish its natural timing or distinguish subtle breathing from the dominant zoom.

must_haves.item: Her face does not morph, drift, develop asymmetry or change identity between frames.
must_haves.why: Identity remains recognizable, but eye definition and cheek details change relative to the source, so exact facial preservation is not achieved.

must_haves.item: Her curly dark hair, sweater and park setting remain consistent with the source.
must_haves.why: The dark curls, gray knitted sweater and green park remain consistent where visible, although the zoom progressively crops them.

must_haves.item: The square framing and camera stay fixed in a silent video lasting approximately 5 seconds.
must_haves.why: The video is square, approximately 5.2 seconds long and silent according to the supplied audio report, but the framing progressively tightens substantially.
